mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity valuation and encourage risk-taking.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over a one-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE increases by >0.3pp in one month, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) falls below 1.0% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth rate < 1.0% and UNRATE > 5.5%, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105, it signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 105, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% signals rising inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in potential monetary tightening.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2.5%, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) falls below 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it indicates a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.5%, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The level of housing starts (HOUST) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as strong housing activity signals a healthy economy and increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between HOUST and 20-day forward returns is not significant (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential fixed investment (RSAFS) above 440000 indicates strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 440000, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
